title: I started adding a story mode to my monster bullet hell
author: Square-Yam-3772
selftext:
I've been taking a break from combat polishes and working on a small story mode.

Right now it's just the protagonist leaving her apartment and walking around the city, but I'm really enjoying the change of pace.

I wanted the world to feel like there's an actual life outside the arena fights.

Still very early, but I'd love to hear what people think.

graphics: GPT image 2 with some manual editing

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body:
I use Unity. 

it is okay, the story mode isn't a main feature of the game so right now it is one town + 3 interior maps + 8-9 characters. It plays out like a small pokemon gym fight sequence with some pickups and dialogue choices (the main currency works for the main mode)

the project itself doesn't seem to be taking off (only has 28 wishlist after a week of bullet fest) so I may be release the full game around late June/July and move on
